text:
elaine: Heads-up — Nimbus QBR scheduled next Tue. Need final token econ slide, 90/30-day spend forecast, and any budget alert stories. Can folks drop numbers here? :eyes:

mike: I can pull the 30/90 burn and compute normalized per-embed/token. Do we want to show current commit vs projected? Also recommend we propose a soft credit-threshold (60%) + auto-throttle plan.

sanjay: +1. Also highlight that enabling prefix caching reduced peak tokens by ~18% in last sprint. I'll add a small APAC vs US regional cost diff.

elaine: Great — mike, can you include monthly run-rate and a "what-if" using 20% growth? jess, can you confirm enablement status: docs, 1:1 cadence, and outstanding asks?

jess: Docs are in the onboarding folder, onboarding session scheduled Fri. Outstanding asks: role-based API keys and a request for a sample prompt set for evals. I'll capture action items.

mike: FYI pulled numbers — quick snapshot:
```
30d_burn: $12,400
90d_burn: $33,800
current_commit: $30,000/mo
proj_+20%: $36,000/mo
unit_cost/token (embeddings): $0.0002
```
Recommend: propose commit increase to $33k + 60% threshold alert.

elaine: Nice. Sanjay — can you draft the cost slide showing savings options: quantize -> 15% savings, batching -> 12% savings, prefix cache -> 10% savings. Keep the language non-technical for execs.

sanjay: Will do. I'll add an A/B bar showing 'Projected vs Mitigated' and call out SLA impact if we switch to smaller model variant.

deploy-bot: [alert] usage_alert: nimbus-prod crossed 55% of monthly commit — triggered at 50% (2025-04-12T10:21Z)

mike: Good to have that alert screenshot. Elaine — add to "QBR risks" slide: near-term threshold, ask to approve soft top-up or overage guardrail.

elaine: Putting together slides now. Action items:
- mike: final numbers + screenshot by EOD
- jess: enablement checklist and ask for prompt set
- sanjay: cost mitigation slide & visuals
I'll draft a one-pager summary for CSM to review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sanjay: ETA for slides? I can deliver mock by 3pm PST.

mike: Numbers + CSV by 5pm PST.

jess: I’ll ping customer for prompt set and update here by EOD.

elaine: Thanks team — gonna synthesize and send to leadership for pre-read. If anyone sees a material delta, flag it here.

mike: noted. One last thought — propose we show "cost per 1k queries" metric; it's a simpler exec-friendly stat.

elaine: Agree. Add that in. Thanks all.
